t: A Zigbee hub radio that links smart home gadgets to a home server.
steps: Buy an SLZB-06 or the newer SLZB-06U from a shop on the SMLIGHT distributor list. European shops charge about 38 to 48 euros.
Set up Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT on a home server first.
Connect the coordinator to a PoE switch with a network cable, or power it from USB-C.
Open its web settings page from a browser on your network.
Add the coordinator to Zigbee2MQTT or the ZHA setup in Home Assistant.
Pair your first Zigbee bulb or sensor and switch it from your phone.
